card.name: Quantity words after "only"
card.fires_on: Limiting quantity words such as so, much, part, some, enough or until that come right after "only" or "can only" and set a limit on an amount or extent.

modes.label: so / much after only
modes.description: A degree word follows "only" or "can only" and caps how far or how large something goes.
modes.example: the subsystem can only grow<< so>> large compared to the system that contains it

modes.label: part / some / enough after only
modes.description: A partial-amount word follows "only" to say something is incomplete or limited.
modes.example: will go only<< part>> way toward solving a second serious, and

modes.label: until after only
modes.description: A limit word follows "only" to say when something should stop.
modes.example: high dose corticosteroid therapy should be continued only<< until>> the patient’s condition has stabilized; usually
